text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Guh, both Royce-kun and Ticket are getting 
stronger...!! In that case――

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I can just break away from this pack! 
Hyaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Where should I aim...? I don't know... I 
really don't know, but—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd ever lose! Not to Hayahide, and 
not to Royce! Doryaaaaaaah!!

Everyone runs while confronting their own 
inner drive. And in the midst of it—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up! I refuse to—give up! 
Daaaaaaahhh!

Come the spring of the Classic year, that 
unmistakable difference in ability had 
narrowed significantly.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Held nothing back... went all 
out... I'm exhausted, but still...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A winner and a loser were decided. And 
besides...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(That faint feeling... that I felt while 
running...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Royce... not bad. You've really fired me 
up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're right, there's no point in 
constantly worrying about who's chasing 
me. ...I can honestly feel that way now.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Royce-Royce! Today's race was soooooo 
incredibly exciting—!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's been so long since I was this 
engrossed in something! It's all thanks to 
you, Royce!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Thanks to me...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: No, well... a little bit, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Tenno Sho (Autumn). That's 
where the Autumn GⅠ campaign begins.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, let's both push ourselves to 
the limit and settle this."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Yes! I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we did everything we could.
choice_data_list: Ah, that was a great run!
Yeah, that was a great run!

text_block_list.text:
It was the result of the relentless 
training she carried out alongside her 
self-producing efforts.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"There's no such thing as the 'strongest' 
in a prep race, but I've certainly proved 
I've got what it takes."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
All that remains is how I truly feel... 
The "core" of who I am...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up! I refuse to—give up! 
Daaaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(That thrilling shiver that welled up 
while I was running. And then...)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's been so long since I was this 
engrossed in something! It's all thanks to 
you, Royce!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Thanks to me...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if that's... unrelated. No, 
but...)
choice_data_list: What's wrong? Did you find the "core"?
What's wrong, did you find the "core"?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: No, we can't be sure yet. However...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I think I've found a starting point. I 
need to dive deeper. Deep down—into her 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know how deep I need to dive. 
But! I won't give up until I find it."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Unless she somehow becomes conscious of 
her "core," develops it, and projects it 
strongly—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'll never become the “strongest” 
Umamusume— the kind who shakes people's 
hearts and leaves a lasting memory!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Next up is—the Tenno Sho (Autumn), right?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, looks like tough competition is 
gathering, but...

Yeah, looks like a lot of strong 
competitors will be gathering, though.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, bring it on. It's precisely because 
so many distinct personalities gather 
here—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You'll be able to recognize your own 
individuality much more clearly! Lend me a 
hand, Trainer!
